muyesser-irab:1-1.t: ﴿حم﴾: the discussion of the disjointed letters (al-ḥurūf al-muqaṭṭaʿa) has preceded at the beginning of Surat al-Baqara.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t: ﴿تنزيل من الرحمن الرحيم﴾: تنزيل: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "it is a revelation" (هو تنزيل). ومن الرحمن: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿تنزيل﴾. والرحيم: naʿt. Or ﴿تنزيل﴾ is mubtadaʾ, and His word ﴿كتاب﴾ in the following ayah is its khabar; beginning with ﴿تنزيل﴾ is permissible because it is specified by the adjective.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t: ﴿كتاب فصلت آياته قرآنا عربيا لقوم يعلمون﴾: كتاب: badal (substitute) of تنزيل, or a khabar (predicate) after a khabar. The clause ﴿فصلت﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿كتاب﴾; فصلت: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the tāʾ is for the feminine. وآياته: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). وقرآنًا: ḥāl (circumstantial) of كتاب. وعربيًّا: naʿt of ﴿قرآنا﴾. ولقوم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿فصلت﴾, or attached to an omitted second naʿt of ﴿قرآنا﴾. The clause ﴿يعلمون﴾ is a naʿt of ﴿قوم﴾.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t: ﴿بشيرا ونذيرا فأعرض أكثرهم فهم لا يسمعون﴾: ﴿بشيرا﴾: naʿt (adjective) of ﴿قرآنًا﴾, or ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿كتاب﴾. ونذيرا: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to ﴿بشيرًا﴾. ﴿فأعرض﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and أعرض is a past verb. وأكثرهم: fāʿil (agent); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the mīm is the sign of the plural. فهم: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and هم is mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿لا يسمعون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of هم.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿وقالوا قلوبنا في أكنة مما تدعونا إليه وفي آذاننا وقر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or resumptive. وقالوا: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). وقلوبنا: mubtadaʾ (subject). وفي أكنة: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted khabar (predicate). ومما: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to something omitted, the implied form being: "in coverings that prevent us from what you call us to" (في أكنة تمنعنا مما تدعونا إليه). The clause ﴿تدعونا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿وقالوا قلوبنا...﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿أعرض أكثرهم﴾ in the previous ayah, or resumptive with no grammatical position. وفي آذاننا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ووقر: delayed mubtadaʾ.
﴿ومن بيننا وبينك حجاب فاعمل إننا عاملون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ومن بيننا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. وبينك: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to بيننا. وحجاب: delayed mubtadaʾ. فاعمل: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition), and اعمل is an imperative verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil. وإننا: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun. وعاملون: its khabar.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿قل إنما أنا بشر مثلكم يوحى إلي أنما إلهكم إله واحد﴾: قل: an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). إنما: the restraining and restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa). وأنا: mubtadaʾ (subject). وبشر: khabar (predicate). ومثلكم: naʿt (adjective); the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause ﴿يوحى﴾ is a second naʿt of بشر; ويوحى: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive). وإلي: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿يوحى﴾. وأنما: kāffa wa-makfūfa. وإلهكم: mubtadaʾ. وإله: khabar. وواحد: naʿt. The interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أنما إلهكم ...﴾ is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿فاستقيموا إليه واستغفروه وويل للمشركين﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition). واستقيموا: an imperative verb and its fāʿil. واستغفروه: conjoined to فاستقيموا, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). وويل: the wāw is a conjunction, and ويل is mubtadaʾ; beginning with it is permissible because of the meaning of imprecation in it. وللمشركين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿الذين لا يؤتون الزكاة﴾: الذين: naʿt (adjective). The clause ﴿لا يؤتون الزكاة﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ولا: negative. ويؤتون: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is fāʿil (agent). والزكاة: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وهم بالآخرة هم كافرون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. وهم: mubtadaʾ (subject). وبالآخرة: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿كافرون﴾. The second هم: tawkīd (emphasis) of the first. وكافرون: the khabar (predicate) of هم.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t: ﴿إن الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات لهم أجر غير ممنون﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. وإن: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters). والذين: its noun. The clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position; وآمن: a past verb, and the wāw is fāʿil (agent). وعملوا: conjoined to آمنوا. والصالحات: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra. ولهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). وأجر: delayed mubtadaʾ (subject). وغير: naʿt (adjective). وممنون: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The nominal clause is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿قل أئنكم لتكفرون بالذي خلق الأرض في يومين﴾: the hamza is interrogative. وإن: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and ﴿كم﴾ is its noun. The lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). The clause ﴿تكفرون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن. وبالذي: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿تكفرون﴾. The clause ﴿خلق الأرض﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. وفي يومين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خلق﴾.
﴿وتجعلون له أندادا ذلك رب العالمين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿تجعلون﴾ is conjoined to ﴿تكفرون﴾. وله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second object of تجعلون. وأندادًا: its first object. وذلك: mubtadaʾ (subject); the reference is to الذي in view of its being described by what the ṣila indicated. ورب: its khabar. والعالمين: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿وجعل فيها رواسي من فوقها وبارك فيها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to خلق الأرض. وفيها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted second object. ورواسي: the first object of جعل. It is also valid to attach the preposition and its genitive noun to جعل, taking it in the sense of "created" (خلق), in which case it puts only one object in the accusative. ومن فوقها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of رواسي. [Translator's note: the source does not parse ﴿وبارك فيها﴾.]
﴿وقدر فيها أقواتها في أربعة أيام سواء للسائلين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. وقدر: a past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). وفيها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قدر﴾. وأقواتها: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). وفي أربعة أيام: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿قدر﴾; وأيام: muḍāf ilayhi. وسواء: ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿أيام﴾, i.e. complete, with no deficiency or excess in them. وللسائلين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted verb [Translator's note: so in the source; no omitted verb has been named in this entry]. Or ﴿سواء﴾ is parsed [Translator's note: the source has «تعراب», apparently for «تُعرب»] as ḥāl of the pronoun in أقواتها.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿ثم استوى إلى السماء وهي دخان﴾: ثم: a conjunction. واستوى: a past verb; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو". وإلى السماء: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿استوى﴾. The wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). و﴿هي﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ودخان: khabar (predicate).
﴿فقال لها وللأرض ائتيا طوعا أو كرها قالتا أتينا طائعين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction. وقال: a past verb; its fāʿil is latent, referring to Allah the Exalted. ولها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قال﴾. وللأرض: conjoined to ﴿لها﴾. وائتيا: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the alif of the dual is fāʿil. ﴿طوعًا وكرهًا﴾: two maṣdars (verbal nouns) in the position of ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. willing or unwilling (طائعتين أو كارهتين). [Translator's note: the source writes «طوعًا وكرهًا» with wāw where the ayah has أو, and does not parse ﴿قالتا أتينا طائعين﴾.]

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿فقضاهن سبع سماوات في يومين وأوحى في كل سماء أمرها﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction. وقضاهن: a past verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). وسبع: second object of ﴿قضاهن﴾, because it has been made to include the meaning of صيّر (to make into). وسماوات: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). وفي يومين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿قضاهن﴾. وأوحى: the wāw is a conjunction, and أوحى is a past verb with a latent fāʿil. وفي كل: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أوحى﴾. وسماء: muḍāf ilayhi. وأمرها: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿وزينا السماء الدنيا بمصابيح وحفظا ذلك تقدير العزيز العليم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. وزينا: a verb and its fāʿil. والسماء: mafʿūl bihi. والدنيا: naʿt (adjective). وبمصابيح: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿زينا﴾. وحفظًا: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e. "and We guarded it with a guarding" (وحفظناها حفظًا); or it may be a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) according to the meaning, as if He had said: ﴿وخلقنا المصابيح زينة وحفظًا﴾ (and We created the lamps as adornment and protection). وذلك: mubtadaʾ (subject). وتقدير: muḍāf ilayhi [Translator's note: so in the source; تقدير is evidently the khabar (predicate) of ذلك and is itself the muḍāf]. والعزيز: muḍāf ilayhi. والعليم: naʿt of العزيز, genitive (majrūr).

muyesser-irab:13-13.t: ﴿فإن أعرضوا فقل أنذرتكم صاعقة مثل صاعقة عاد وثمود﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and إن is conditional. وأعرضوا: a past verb, and the wāw is fāʿil (agent); the verb is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). فقل: the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ (rābiṭa), and قل is an imperative verb; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنت". وأنذرتكم: a past verb, its fāʿil, and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). وصاعقة: second mafʿūl bihi. ومثل: naʿt (adjective) of صاعقة. وصاعقة: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and it is itself muḍāf. وعاد: muḍāf ilayhi. وثمود: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to ﴿عاد﴾, genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa because it is a diptote.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿إذ جاءتهم الرسل من بين أيديهم ومن خلفهم﴾: ﴿إذ﴾: an adverb (ẓarf) of ﴿صاعقة عاد وثمود﴾, taking the meaning of الصاعقة to be the punishment; or it is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) of it; or ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb of ﴿قالوا﴾ after it, and the clause is an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī), as if it came in answer to a question whose implied form is: "What was their case?" (ما شأنهم؟). The clause ﴿جاءتهم الرسل﴾ is in the position of genitive by being put in construct (iḍāfa). ﴿من بين﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿جاءتهم﴾, and أيديهم is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); or they are attached to an omitted ḥāl of الرسل, i.e. the messengers being from before ʿĀd and Thamūd. ﴿من خلفهم﴾: conjoined to ﴿من بين أيديهم﴾, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿ألا تعبدوا إلا الله﴾: in ﴿أن﴾ there are three views:
The first: it is lightened from the heavy (anna), and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), omitted; its original form is أنه لا تعبدوا, i.e. "in that the matter and the account is Our saying to you: do not worship anyone but Allah". The clause ﴿لا تعبدوا..﴾ is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate) of the lightened أن, and أن with what falls within its scope is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) accusative by removal of the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl of الرسل, its implied form being "saying" (قائلين). ولا: prohibitive. وتعبدوا: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا. وإلا: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). The Name of Majesty: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
The second view: it is a maṣdar particle that puts into the accusative; ﴿لا﴾ is negative, and ﴿تعبدوا﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن. The interpreted maṣdar from the maṣdariyya ﴿أن﴾ and what falls within its scope is accusative by removal of the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl of الرسل, its implied form being "saying" (قائلين). The clause ﴿لا تعبدوا...﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the maṣdariyya ﴿أن﴾, with no grammatical position.
The third view: it is [Translator's note: a word appears to be missing in the source here, presumably «تفسيرية» (explicative)], because the coming of the messengers carries the sense of saying, and the clause after it is explicative, with no grammatical position.
﴿قالوا لو شاء ربنا لأنزل ملائكة فإنا بما أرسلتم به كافرون﴾: قالوا: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ولو: a non-jussive conditional particle. و﴿شاء ربنا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the mafʿūl bihi is omitted, its implied form being: ﴿إنزال ملائكة بالرسالة إلى الإنس لأنزل إليهم بها ملائكة﴾ (the sending down of angels with the message to humans, He would have sent down angels to them with it). The lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb) of لو. وأنزل: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil. وملائكة: mafʿūl bihi. The fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition). وإن: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun. و﴿بما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿كافرون﴾; the clause ﴿أرسلتم به﴾ is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. Or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, and it together with what follows is interpreted as a maṣdar in the genitive by the bāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿كافرون﴾. وأرسلتم: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the tāʾ is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). وبه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أرسل﴾. وكافرون: the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿فأما عاد فاستكبروا في الأرض بغير الحق﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive. وأما: a particle of condition and detailing. وعاد: mubtadaʾ (subject). The fāʾ links the answer of ﴿أما﴾. The clause استكبروا is the khabar (predicate) of عاد. وفي الأرض: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿استكبروا﴾. وبغير: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); والحق: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause ﴿فأما عاد...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وقالوا من أشد منا قوة﴾: قالوا: conjoined to ﴿فاستكبروا﴾. ومن: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ. وأشد: khabar; the clause is the quoted speech. ومنا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أشد﴾. وقوة: tamyīz (specification).
﴿أولم يروا أن الله الذي خلقهم هو أشد منهم قوة﴾: the hamza is interrogative, and the wāw is a conjunction. The clause ﴿لم يروا﴾ is conjoined to something implied that the context requires, i.e. "Were they heedless and astray, and did they not see?" (أغفلوا وضلوا ولم يروا). أن with what falls within its scope stands in place of the two objects of يروا, because it has the meaning of knowing. وأن: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty is its noun. والذي: naʿt (adjective). The clause ﴿خلقهم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. وهو: mubtadaʾ. وأشد: khabar. ومنهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أشد﴾. وقوة: tamyīz. The clause is the khabar of أن.
﴿وكانوا بآياتنا يجحدون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. وكانوا: a deficient past verb, and the wāw is the noun of كان. وبآياتنا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يجحدون﴾.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿فأرسلنا عليهم ريحا صرصرا في أيام نحسات لنذيقهم عذاب الخزي في الحياة الدنيا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction. وأرسلنا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent). وعليهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿أرسلنا﴾. وريحًا: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). وصرصرًا: naʿt (adjective). وفي أيام: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أرسلنا﴾. ونحسات: naʿt of أيام. ولنذيقهم: the lām is for giving the reason (taʿlīl); نذيقهم: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of reason, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the interpreted maṣdar is genitive by the lām of reason, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أرسلنا﴾. وعذاب: second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿نذيقهم﴾. والخزي: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). وفي الحياة: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نذيقهم﴾. والدنيا: naʿt of الحياة.
﴿ولعذاب الآخرة أخزى وهم لا ينصرون﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the lām is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ). وعذاب: mubtadaʾ (subject). والآخرة: muḍāf ilayhi. وأخزى: khabar (predicate). The clause ﴿ولعذاب الآخرة أخزى﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The wāw is a conjunction. وهم: mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿لا ينصرون﴾ is khabar. ولا: negative. وينصرون: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿وأما ثمود فهديناهم فاستحبوا العمى على الهدى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. وأما: a particle of condition and detailing. وثمود: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فهديناهم﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the answer of ﴿أما﴾; هدينا: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate). ﴿فاستحبوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and استحبوا is conjoined to ﴿هديناهم﴾. والعمى: mafʿūl bihi. وعلى الهدى: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿استحب﴾, because it includes the meaning of "preferred" (آثروا).
﴿فأخذتهم صاعقة العذاب الهون بما كانوا يكسبون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction. وأخذتهم: a past verb and a fronted mafʿūl bihi. وصاعقة: delayed fāʿil. والعذاب: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). والهون: naʿt (adjective) of العذاب. و﴿بما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and ما is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) in the position of genitive; the clause ﴿كانوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. Or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, and it together with what follows is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by the bāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أخذتهم﴾. وكان: a deficient past verb, and the wāw of the plural is its noun; the clause يكسبون is its khabar, and the returning pronoun is omitted, i.e. "for that which they used to earn" (بالذي كانوا يكسبونه) of their associating partners with Allah and their denying their prophet.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t: ﴿ونجينا الذين آمنوا وكانوا يتقون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ونجينا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent). والذين: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. وكانوا: conjoined to ﴿آمنوا﴾; كان is a deficient past verb, and the wāw of the plural is its noun; the clause يتقون is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:19-19.t: ﴿ويوم يحشر أعداء الله إلى النار فهم يوزعون﴾: the wāw is resumptive. ويوم: object of an omitted verb, its implied form being: ﴿اذكر يوم﴾ (remember the day). ويحشر: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); the clause ﴿يحشر﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). وأعداء: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The Name of Majesty: muḍāf ilayhi. وإلى النار: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿يحشر﴾. The clause ﴿ويوم يحشر...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The fāʾ is a conjunction. وهم: mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يوزعون﴾ is khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿حتى إذا ما جاءوها شهد عليهم سمعهم وأبصارهم وجلودهم﴾: حتى: a particle of limit (ghāya). وإذا: an adverb (ẓarf) of future time containing the meaning of condition, attached (mutaʿalliq) to its apodosis, which is شهد. وما: connective (ṣila), to emphasise the testimony. The clause ﴿جاؤوها﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb's being put in construct with it. The clause شهد has no grammatical position. وعليهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿شهد﴾. وسمعهم: fāʿil (agent). ﴿وأبصارهم وجلودهم﴾: both conjoined to ﴿سمعهم﴾.
﴿بما كانوا يعملون﴾: ﴿بما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and ما is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) in the position of genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿شهد﴾; the clause ﴿كانوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. Or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, and it together with what it governs is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by the bāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿شهد﴾. و﴿كانوا﴾: كان is a deficient past verb, and the wāw of the plural is its noun; the clause ﴿يعملون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of كان; ويعملون: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿وقالوا لجلودهم لم شهدتم علينا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. وقالوا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿لجلودهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿قالوا﴾. ﴿لِمَ﴾: the lām is a preposition, and ما is an interrogative noun in the genitive by the lām, which is why its alif was dropped; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿شهدتم﴾. ﴿علينا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿شهدتم﴾. The clause is the quoted speech.
﴿قالوا أنطقنا الله الذي أنطق كل شيء﴾: قالوا: a verb and its fāʿil. وأنطقنا الله: a past verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a fāʿil; the clause is the quoted speech. والذي: naʿt (adjective) of الله. The clause ﴿أنطق كل شيء﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position. وأنطق: a past verb, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). وكل: mafʿūl bihi. وشيء: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وهو خلقكم أول مرة وإليه ترجعون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. وهو: mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿خلقكم﴾ is khabar (predicate). وأول: an adverb attached to ﴿خلقكم﴾. ومرة: muḍāf ilayhi. و﴿إليه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ترجعون﴾. وترجعون: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿وما كنتم تستترون أن يشهد عليكم سمعكم ولا أبصاركم ولا جلودكم﴾: the wāw is resumptive. وما: negative. وكنتم: كان is a deficient past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; the clause ﴿تستترون﴾ is its khabar (predicate). The clause ﴿وما كنتم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. أن with what falls within its scope is accusative by removal of the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿تستترون﴾, i.e. "from that it should testify against you" (من أن يشهد عليكم), because تستترون is not transitive by itself. It has also been said: it is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) with an implied muḍāf, i.e. "for fear that your hearing should testify against you" (مخافة أن يشهد عليكم سمعكم). وعليكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يشهد﴾. وسمعكم: fāʿil (agent), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ولا أبصاركم، ولا جلودكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ولا is connective (ṣila), to emphasise the negation; وأبصاركم: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to سمعكم, nominative (marfūʿ), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ولا جلودكم﴾: also conjoined to سمعكم.
﴿ولكن ظننتم أن الله لا يعلم كثيرا مما تعملون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ولكن: a particle of rectification (istidrāk), inoperative. وظننتم: a verb and its fāʿil. أن with what falls within its scope stands in place of the two objects of ظننتم. وأن: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause ﴿لا يعلم﴾ is its khabar. وكثيرًا: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). و﴿مما﴾: من is a preposition, and ما is a relative noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿كثيرًا﴾. The clause تعلمون [Translator's note: so in the source; the ayah has تعملون] is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position, and the returning pronoun is omitted, i.e. تعلمونه. Or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, and it together with what follows is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by من; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt of ﴿كثيرًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t: ﴿وذلكم ظنكم الذي ظننتم بربكم أرداكم فأصبحتم من الخاسرين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. وذلكم: mubtadaʾ (subject). وظنكم: khabar (predicate). والذي: a relative noun in the position of nominative as badal (substitute), ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) or naʿt (adjective) of ظنكم. و﴿ظننتم﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿ظننتم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. وبربكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿ظننتم﴾. و﴿أرداكم﴾: a verb, its fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿أرداكم﴾ is a second khabar. Or ظنكم may be parsed as badal of ذلكم; or ظنكم is khabar and the clause أرداكم is ḥāl (circumstantial) with ﴿قد﴾ implied before it. ﴿فأصبحتم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; أصبح is a deficient past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun. ومن الخاسرين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿فإن يصبروا فالنار مثوى لهم﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive. وإن: conditional. ويصبروا: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); يصبروا: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is fāʿil (agent). The fāʾ is the linking fāʾ (rābiṭa). والنار: mubtadaʾ (subject). ومثوى: khabar (predicate). ولهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of مثوى. The clause ﴿فإن يصبروا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وإن يستعتبوا فما هم من المعتبين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. وإن: conditional. ويستعتبوا: a verb and its fāʿil. The fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿ما﴾: the Ḥijāzī negative, which operates like ليس. وهم: a pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī) in the position of nominative as the noun of ما. ﴿من المعتبين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of ما. Or ﴿ما﴾ is negative and inoperative, ﴿هم﴾ is a pronoun, indeclinable in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, and ﴿من المعتبين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ. The clause ﴿فما هم من المعتبين﴾ is the apodosis, in the position of jussive.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿وقيضنا لهم قرناء فزينوا لهم ما بين أيديهم وما خلفهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. وقيضنا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent). ولهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿قيضنا﴾. وقرناء: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). فزينوا: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and زينوا is a verb and its fāʿil. ولهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿زينوا﴾. وما: a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. وبين: an adverb attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾; the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. وأيديهم: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وما خلفهم﴾: conjoined to ﴿ما بين أيديهم﴾.
﴿وحق عليهم القول في أمم قد خلت من قبلهم من الجن والإنس إنهم كانوا خاسرين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. وحق: a past verb. وعليهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿حق﴾. والقول: fāʿil. وفي أمم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in عليهم, i.e. being among the number of nations, or included among them. و﴿قد﴾: a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). وخلت: a past verb, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). The clause ﴿قد خلت﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أمم﴾. ومن قبلهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خلت﴾. ومن الجن: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second naʿt of أمم, or ḥāl of the pronoun in خلت. والإنس: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الجن. ﴿إنهم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and ﴿هم﴾ is its noun; the clause ﴿كانوا﴾ is its khabar (predicate). وكان: a deficient past verb, and the wāw of the plural is its noun. وخاسرين: the khabar of كان. The clause of ﴿إن﴾ and what follows it gives the reason (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:26-26.t: ﴿وقال الذين كفروا لا تسمعوا لهذا القرآن والغوا فيه لعلكم تغلبون﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. و﴿قال الذين﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent). وكفروا: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ولا: prohibitive. وتسمعوا: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is the quoted speech. ولهذا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿تسمعوا﴾. والقرآن: badal (substitute). والغوا: an imperative verb and its fāʿil. وفيه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿الغوا﴾. ولعل: an abrogating particle conveying hope (tarajjī), and ﴿الكاف﴾ is its noun. وتغلبون: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause ﴿تغلبون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of لعل.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿فلنذيقن الذين كفروا عذابا شديدا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition). The lām occurs in the answer to an implied oath. ونذيقن: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, necessarily emphasised; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "نحن". والذين: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). وكفروا: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. وعذابًا: mafʿūl bihi. وشديدًا: naʿt (adjective).
﴿ولنجزينهم أسوأ الذي كانوا يعملون﴾: ولنجزينهم: like لنذيقن, and the pronoun is in the position of accusative as first mafʿūl bihi. وأسوأ: second object of ﴿نجزي﴾. والذي: a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). وكانوا: a deficient past verb, and the wāw is the noun of كان. ويعملون: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause ﴿يعملون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿كان﴾.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿ذلك جزاء أعداء الله النار﴾: ذلك: mubtadaʾ (subject). وجزاء: khabar (predicate). وأعداء: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and it is itself muḍāf. The Name of Majesty: muḍāf ilayhi. والنار: badal (substitute) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of جزاء. The preferred view is to parse النار as khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being: هي; or as mubtadaʾ whose khabar is ﴿لهم فيها دار الخلد﴾.
﴿لهم فيها دار الخلد جزاء بما كانوا بآياتنا يجحدون﴾: لهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted fronted khabar. وفيها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ودار: delayed mubtadaʾ. والخلد: muḍāf ilayhi. The clause is either the khabar of النار, on the basis of parsing it as mubtadaʾ; or in the position of accusative as ḥāl; or an independent resumptive clause confirming what precedes it, with no grammatical position. وجزاء: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. for the sake of recompense; or mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e. "they are recompensed with a recompense" (يجزون جزاء). و﴿بما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and ما is a relative noun in the position of genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿جزاء﴾; the clause كانوا is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. Or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, and it together with what follows is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by the bāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿جزاء﴾. وكانوا: a deficient, abrogating past verb, and the wāw of the plural is its noun; the clause ﴿يجحدون﴾ is the khabar of ﴿كان﴾. وبآياتنا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يجحدون﴾. ويجحدون: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is fāʿil (agent).

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿وقال الذين كفروا ربنا أرنا اللذين أضلانا من الجن والإنس﴾: the wāw is resumptive. و﴿قال الذين﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent). The clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. وربنا: the one addressed (munādā), muḍāf, with the vocative particle omitted. وأرنا: a verb of supplication, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter; ﴿نا﴾ is a pronoun, indeclinable in the position of accusative as first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). واللذين: second mafʿūl bihi. The clause ﴿أضلانا﴾ is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. ومن الجن: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil. والإنس: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الجن. The clause ﴿وقال الذين كفروا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿نجعلهما تحت أقدامنا ليكونا من الأسفلين﴾: نجعلهما: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the request; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "نحن"; the hāʾ is first mafʿūl bihi. وتحت: an adverb attached to an omitted second object. وأقدامنا: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and it is itself muḍāf; ﴿نا﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. و﴿ليكونا﴾: the lām is for giving the reason (taʿlīl); يكونا: a deficient, abrogating imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of reason; the interpreted maṣdar from the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the lām with its genitive noun is attached to ﴿نجعل﴾. The alif of the dual is the noun of يكون. ومن الأسفلين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of يكون.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿إن الذين قالوا ربنا الله ثم استقاموا تتنزل عليهم الملائكة﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. وإن: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and الذين is its noun. The clause ﴿قالوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ورب: mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿نا﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the Name of Majesty: khabar (predicate); the clause is the quoted speech. وثم: a conjunction. واستقاموا: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). وتتنزل: an imperfect verb. والملائكة: fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ). وعليهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿تتنزل﴾. The clause ﴿تتنزل عليهم الملائكة﴾ is the khabar of إن.
﴿ألا تخافوا ولا تحزنوا وأبشروا بالجنة التي كنتم توعدون﴾: ﴿ألّا﴾: ﴿أن﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya) and ﴿لا﴾ is prohibitive. وتخافوا: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw of the plural is fāʿil; the clause ﴿لا تخافوا﴾ is explicative, with no grammatical position. Or ﴿أن﴾ is maṣdariyya and ﴿لا﴾ is negative; تخافوا: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the interpreted maṣdar from the maṣdariyya ﴿أن﴾ and what follows it is accusative by removal of the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿تتنزل﴾, the implied form being: تتنزل بأن لا تخافوا, i.e. with the absence of fear; the clause ﴿لا تخافوا﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdariyya ﴿أن﴾, with no grammatical position. ﴿ولا تحزنوا﴾: conjoined to ﴿لا تخافوا﴾. ﴿وأبشروا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أبشروا: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil. وبالجنة: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أبشروا﴾. والتي: a relative noun in the position of genitive as naʿt (adjective) of الجنة. The clause ﴿كنتم﴾ is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. وكان: a deficient past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; the clause ﴿توعدون﴾ is the khabar of كان. وتوعدون: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw of the plural is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿نحن أولياؤكم في الحياة الدنيا وفي الآخرة﴾: نحن: mubtadaʾ (subject). وأولياؤكم: khabar (predicate). وفي الحياة: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿أولياؤكم﴾; it is also valid to attach it to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). والدنيا: naʿt (adjective) of الحياة. ﴿وفي الآخر﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source, for ﴿وفي الآخرة﴾]: conjoined to ﴿في الحياة الدنيا﴾.
﴿ولكم فيها ما تشتهي أنفسكم ولكم فيها ما تدعون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ولكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. وفيها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. وما: a relative noun in the position of nominative as delayed mubtadaʾ. The clause ﴿تشتهي أنفسكم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position; the returning pronoun is omitted and is the object of تشتهي, i.e. "that which your souls desire" (الذي تشتهيه أنفسكم). ﴿ولكم فيها ما تدعون﴾: conjoined to the preceding clause. ولكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. وفيها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. وما: a relative noun in the position of nominative as delayed mubtadaʾ. The clause ﴿تدعون﴾ is the ṣila, with no grammatical position; the returning pronoun is omitted and is the object of تدعون, i.e. "that which you ask for" (الذي تدعونه).

muyesser-irab:32-32.t: ﴿نزلا من غفور رحيم﴾: نزلا: ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿ما تدعون﴾ or of the omitted returning pronoun, on the understanding that by النُّزُل is meant what is prepared for a guest of food and the like. و﴿من غفور﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿نزلا﴾. ورحيم: naʿt.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t: ﴿ومن أحسن قولا ممن دعا إلى الله وعمل صالحا وقال إنني من المسلمين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ومن: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). وأحسن: khabar (predicate). وقولًا: tamyīz (specification). وممن: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿أحسن﴾. ودعا: a past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). وإلى الله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿دعا﴾. The clause ﴿دعا إلى الله﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position. ﴿وعمل صالحًا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; وعمل: a verb with a latent fāʿil. وصالحًا: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿عمل﴾, or standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of the maṣdar, i.e. "he did a righteous deed" (عمل عملًا صالحًا). وقال: conjoined to what precedes it. و﴿إنني﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and the yāʾ is its noun. ومن المسلمين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of إن. The clause ﴿إنني﴾ is in the position of accusative, because it is the quoted speech.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿ولا تستوي الحسنة ولا السيئة ادفع بالتي هي أحسن﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and لا is negative. و﴿تستوي الحسنة﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿ولا السيئة﴾: conjoined to ﴿الحسنة﴾. The clause ﴿ولا تستوي...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. وادفع: an imperative verb, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). وبالتي: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿ادفع﴾; التي is an adjective of an omitted noun it qualifies, i.e. "with the trait" (بالخصلة). وهي: mubtadaʾ (subject). وأحسن: khabar (predicate). The clause ﴿هي أحسن﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position.
﴿فإذا الذي بينك وبينه عداوة كأنه ولي حميم﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition), and إذا is that of surprise (fujāʾiyya). والذي: a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. وبينك: an adverb of place, accusative (manṣūb), attached to an omitted fronted khabar; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). وبينه: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to بينك. عداوة: delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ). كأنه ولي: كأن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the hāʾ is its noun, and ولي is its khabar. وحميم: naʿt (adjective). The clause ﴿كأنه ولي﴾ is in the position of nominative as khabar of ﴿الذي﴾.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿وما يلقاها إلا الذين صبروا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is negative. ويلقاها: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); ﴿ها﴾ is second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). وإلا: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). والذين: the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of يلقاها. وصبروا: a past verb, and the wāw is fāʿil (agent). The clause ﴿صبروا﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause).
﴿وما يلقاها إلا ذو حظ عظيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is negative. ويلقاها: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); ﴿ها﴾ is second mafʿūl bihi. وإلا: a particle of restriction. و﴿ذو﴾: the nāʾib fāʿil of ﴿يلقاها﴾. وحظ: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). وعظيم: naʿt (adjective) of حظ.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t: ﴿وإما ينزغنك من الشيطان نزغ فاستعذ بالله إنه هو السميع العليم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. وإن: conditional, its nūn assimilated into the connective (ṣila) ﴿ما﴾. وينزغنك: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the kāf is fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ومن الشيطان: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally an adjective of نزغ. ونزغ: delayed fāʿil (agent). ﴿فاستعذ﴾: the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ (rābiṭa), and استعذ is an imperative verb; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنت". وبالله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿استعذ﴾. ﴿إنه هو السميع العليم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and the hāʾ is its noun. و﴿هو﴾: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), or mubtadaʾ (subject). والسميع العليم: two khabars (predicates) of ﴿إن﴾, or two khabars of ﴿هو﴾, in which case the clause ﴿هو السميع العليم﴾ is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿ومن آياته الليل والنهار والشمس والقمر﴾: the wāw is resumptive. و﴿من آياته﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). والليل: delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), and what follows it is conjoined to it. The clause ﴿ومن آياته...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿لا تسجدوا للشمس ولا للقمر واسجدوا لله الذي خلقهن إن كنتم إياه تعبدون﴾: لا: prohibitive. وتسجدوا: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا. وللشمس: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تسجدوا﴾. ﴿ولا للقمر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ولا is connective (ṣila), to emphasise the negation; و﴿للقمر﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تسجدوا﴾. ﴿واسجدوا لله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; واسجدوا: an imperative verb, and the wāw is fāʿil (agent). ولله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿اسجدوا﴾. والذي: naʿt (adjective) of الله. وخلقهن: a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil, and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿خلقهن﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. وإن: conditional. وكنتم: a deficient past verb, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is its noun. وإياه: fronted object of تعبدون. وتعبدون: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause ﴿تعبدون﴾ is the khabar of كنتم. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being: فاسجدوا له (then prostrate to Him).

muyesser-irab:38-38.t: ﴿فإن استكبروا فالذين عند ربك يسبحون له بالليل والنهار وهم لا يسأمون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and إن is conditional. واستكبروا: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). فالذين: the fāʾ gives the reason for the omitted apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), whose implied form is: فدعهم وشأنهم (then leave them to their affair). والذين: mubtadaʾ (subject). وعند: an adverb attached (mutaʿalliq) to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿الذين﴾; the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. وربك: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ويسبحون: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause ﴿يسبحون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of الذين. و﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يسبحون﴾. وبالليل: a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to ﴿يسبحون﴾. والنهار: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الليل, genitive (majrūr). ﴿وهم لا يسأمون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or circumstantial (ḥāliyya). وهم: mubtadaʾ. ولا: negative. ويسأمون: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause ﴿لا يسأمون﴾ is khabar.

muyesser-irab:39-39.t:
﴿ومن آياته أنك ترى الأرض خاشعة فإذا أنزلنا عليها الماء اهتزت وربت﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. و﴿من آياته﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). أن with what falls within its scope: delayed mubtadaʾ (subject). وأنك: أن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and the kāf is its noun. و﴿ترى الأرض﴾: a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿ترى الأرض﴾ is the khabar of ﴿أن﴾. وخاشعة: ḥāl (circumstantial); or the seeing is of knowledge (ʿilmiyya), and ﴿خاشعة﴾ is second mafʿūl bihi. فإذا: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and إذا is a future adverb (ẓarf) containing the meaning of condition. و﴿أنزلنا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause ﴿أنزلنا﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb's being put in construct with it. وعليها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أنزلنا﴾. والماء: mafʿūl bihi. و﴿اهتزت﴾: a past verb, and its fāʿil is latent; the clause ﴿اهتزت﴾ has no grammatical position. ﴿وربت﴾: conjoined to ﴿اهتزت﴾.
﴿إن الذي أحياها لمحيي الموتى إنه على كل شيء قدير﴾: إن: an abrogating particle, and الذي is its noun. و﴿أحياها﴾: a verb and a latent fāʿil, and ﴿ها﴾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿أحياها﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. The lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). ومحيي: the khabar of إن. والموتى: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إنه﴾: إن is an abrogating particle, and the hāʾ is its noun. وعلى كل: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قدير﴾. وشيء: muḍāf ilayhi. وقدير: the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t:
﴿إن الذين يلحدون في آياتنا لا يخفون علينا﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. وإن: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and الذين is its noun. و﴿يلحدون﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿يلحدون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. وفي آياتنا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿يلحدون﴾. ولا: negative. ويخفون: a verb and its fāʿil. وعلينا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يخفون﴾. The clause ﴿لا يخفون علينا﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن.
﴿أفمن يلقى في النار خير أم من يأتي آمنا يوم القيامة﴾: the hamza is interrogative, and the fāʾ conjoins to something implied that the context requires. ومن: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ويلقى: a verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil. وفي النار: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يلقى﴾. The clause ﴿يلقى في النار﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position. وخير: the khabar of ﴿مَن﴾. وأم: a conjunction. ومَن: conjoined to the first من. و﴿يأتي﴾: a verb with a latent fāʿil; the clause ﴿يأتي﴾ is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. وآمنا: ḥāl (circumstantial). ويوم: an adverb attached to ﴿يأتي﴾. والقيامة: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿اعملوا ما شئتم إنه بما تعملون بصير﴾: اعملوا: an imperative verb, and the wāw is fāʿil. وما: a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). و﴿شئتم﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause ﴿شئتم﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. وإن: an abrogating particle, and the hāʾ is its noun; the clause إنه gives the reason for the command. و﴿بما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and ما is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) in the position of genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿بصير﴾; the clause ﴿تعملون﴾ is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. Or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, so it together with what it governs is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by the bāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿بصير﴾. وبصير: the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t:
﴿إن الذين كفروا بالذكر لما جاءهم﴾: the clause is badal (substitute) of the preceding clause. وإن: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and الذين is its noun. وكفروا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. وبالذكر: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb ﴿كفر﴾. ولما: temporal (ḥīniyya), or linking (rābiṭa). وجاءهم: a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil, and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). On the khabar (predicate) of إن there are several views; the most evident is that it is omitted, its implied form being: ﴿لا يخفون علينا﴾. This view is supported by the second ﴿إن الذين﴾ being a badal of the first ﴿إن الذين﴾, so what applies to the first applies to it; the rule is that whatever is predicated of the badal is predicated of the one it replaces. There are other views, as follows:
1 - It is omitted because the meaning is understood, its implied form being: "will be punished" (معذبون) or "will be destroyed" (مهلكون); this too is a sound view.
2 - It is omitted, its implied form being: "We will recompense them" (نجازيهم).
3 - It is present and mentioned, namely His later words: ﴿أولئك ينادون﴾.
4 - It is present and mentioned, namely His words: ﴿لا يأتيه الباطل﴾, with the returning pronoun omitted, i.e. "falsehood from them does not come to it", like ﴿السمن منوان بدرهم﴾ (ghee: two manns for a dirham), i.e. two manns of it; the al- is a substitute for the pronoun, the implied form being: "those who disbelieved in the Reminder, their falsehood does not come to it" (إن الذين كفروا بالذكر لا يأتيه باطلهم).
5 - The khabar is His words: ﴿ما يقال لك﴾, with the returning pronoun omitted, its implied form being: "those who disbelieved in the Reminder, nothing is said to you about them except what was said to the messengers before you" (إن الذين كفروا بالذكر ما يقال لك في شأنهم إلا ما قد قيل للرسل من قبلك).
﴿وإنه لكتاب عزيز﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). وإنه: the wāw is circumstantial; إن is an abrogating particle, and the hāʾ is its noun. The lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). وكتاب: its khabar. وعزيز: naʿt (adjective). The clause is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) of الذكر.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t: ﴿لا يأتيه الباطل من بين يديه ولا من خلفه تنزيل من حكيم حميد﴾: the clause is a second naʿt (adjective) of الكتاب. ولا: negative. و﴿يأتيه الباطل﴾: a verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and a delayed fāʿil (agent). ومن بين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿يأتيه﴾. ويديه: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ولا من خلفه﴾: conjoined to ﴿من بين يديه﴾. وتنزيل: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. هو. ومن حكيم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تنزيل﴾. وحميد: naʿt of حكيم.

muyesser-irab:43-43.t:
﴿ما يقال لك إلا ما قد قيل للرسل من قبلك﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. وما: negative. ويقال: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive). ولك: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿يقال﴾. وإلا: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). وما: a relative noun in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). وقد: a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). وقيل: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named; its nāʾib fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". و﴿للرسل﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قيل﴾. The clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause). ومن قبلك: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿إن ربك لذو مغفرة وذو عقاب أليم﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and رب is its noun; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). وذو: its khabar (predicate). ومغفرة: muḍāf ilayhi. وذو عقاب: conjoined to ﴿ذو مغفرة﴾. وأليم: naʿt (adjective) of ﴿عقاب﴾.

muyesser-irab:44-44.t:
﴿ولو جعلناه قرآنا أعجميا لقالوا لولا فصلت آياته أأعجمي وعربي﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. ولو: conditional. وجعلناه: a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). وقرآنًا: second mafʿūl bihi. وأعجميًا: naʿt (adjective). The lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the clause قالوا has no grammatical position. ولولا: a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ), i.e. "why not" (هلا). وفصلت: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive). وآياته: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). أأعجمي: the hamza is for disapproving interrogation, and أعجمي is khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "Is it…?" (أهو); or أأعجمي is mubtadaʾ and the khabar is omitted, its implied form being: "Are a foreign one and an Arab equal?" (أأعجمي وعربي يستويان).
﴿قل هو للذين آمنوا هدى وشفاء﴾: قل: an imperative verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil, its implied form being "أنت", i.e. say in reply to them. وهو: mubtadaʾ. وللذين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was a naʿt and was put first. وآمنوا: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. وهدى: the khabar of هو. وشفاء: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to ﴿هدى﴾, nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿والذين لا يؤمنون في آذانهم وقر وهو عليهم عمى أولئك ينادون من مكان بعيد﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. والذين: mubtadaʾ. ولا: negative. ويؤمنون: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause ﴿لا يؤمنون﴾ is the ṣila, with no grammatical position, and the returning pronoun is omitted, i.e. به. وفي آذانهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ووقر: delayed mubtadaʾ. The clause ﴿في آذانهم وقر﴾ is the khabar of الذين. و﴿هو﴾: mubtadaʾ. وعليهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of عمى; it is not attached to the maṣdar (verbal noun) because it comes before it. وعمى: delayed mubtadaʾ [Translator's note: so in the source; given that ﴿هو﴾ has just been parsed as mubtadaʾ, عمى would be its khabar]. وأولئك: mubtadaʾ. وينادون: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil; the clause ﴿ينادون﴾ is khabar. ومن مكان: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ينادون﴾. وبعيد: naʿt of مكان.

muyesser-irab:45-45.t:
﴿ولقد آتينا موسى الكتاب فاختلف فيه﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the lām is the answer to the omitted oath; وقد: a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). وآتينا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent). وموسى: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). والكتاب: second mafʿūl bihi. The clause ﴿ولقد آتينا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The fāʾ is a conjunction. واختلف: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir). وفيه: attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿اختلف﴾.
﴿ولولا كلمة سبقت﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ولولا: a particle of non-occurrence due to occurrence (imtināʿ li-wujūd). وكلمة: mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted. وسبقت: a past verb with a latent fāʿil; the clause ﴿سبقت﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of كلمة.
﴿من ربك﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿سبقت﴾. The lām occurs in the answer of لولا.
﴿لقضي﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). وقضي: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named; its nāʾib fāʿil is latent, referring to the maṣdar (verbal noun) understood from قضي, i.e. the judging (القضاء).
﴿بينهم﴾: an adverb attached to ﴿قضي﴾.
﴿وإنهم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and ﴿هم﴾ is its noun. And the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa).
﴿في شك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of إن.
﴿منه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt.
﴿مريب﴾: second naʿt.

muyesser-irab:46-46.t:
﴿من عمل صالحا فلنفسه﴾: من: a conditional noun causing the jussive, mubtadaʾ (subject). وعمل: a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). وصالحًا: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿عمل﴾, or standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of the maṣdar, i.e. "did a righteous deed" (عمل عملًا صالحًا). The fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ولنفسه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted verb, its implied form being "benefited" (نفع) or "did" (عمل); or attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "then the righteous deed is for his own soul" (فالعمل الصالح لنفسه).
﴿ومن أساء فعليها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. من: a conditional noun causing the jussive, mubtadaʾ. وأساء: a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis. فعليها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted verb.
﴿وما ربك بظلام للعبيد﴾: the wāw is resumptive. وما: the Ḥijāzī negative, which operates like ليس. وربك: the noun of ﴿ما﴾, and the kāf is a pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). و﴿بظلام﴾: the bāʾ is a redundant (ṣila) preposition, and ﴿ظلام﴾ is the khabar of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and genitive in form by the bāʾ. وللعبيد: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ظلام﴾. The clause ﴿وما ربك...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿إليه يرد علم الساعة﴾: إليه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿يرد﴾. ويرد: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive). وعلم: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). والساعة: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وما تخرج من ثمرات من أكمامها وما تحمل من أنثى ولا تضع إلا بعلمه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. وما: negative. وتخرج: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). ومِن: a redundant (ṣila) particle. وثمرات: genitive in form by ﴿من﴾, nominative in position as the fāʿil (agent) of تخرج. ومن أكمامها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تخرج﴾. It has also been said: ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of genitive, conjoined to الساعة, i.e. "the knowledge of the Hour and the knowledge of what comes out"; the first ﴿مِن﴾ is for comprehensiveness (istighrāq), and the second ﴿مِن﴾ is for the starting point. The wāw is a conjunction. وما: negative. وتحمل: an imperfect verb, nominative. ومن: a redundant particle. وأنثى: fāʿil, genitive in form and nominative in position. The wāw is a conjunction. ولا: to emphasise the negation. وتضع: an imperfect verb, nominative; the clause ﴿تضع﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿تحمل﴾. وإلا: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). وبعلمه: an emptied exception (istithnāʾ mufarragh) from the most general of states, i.e. "except accompanied by His knowledge" (إلا مقرونًا بعلمه).
﴿ويوم يناديهم أين شركائي قالوا آذناك ما منا من شهيد﴾: ﴿يوم﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, the implied form being: "and remember the day He calls them" (واذكر يوم يناديهم). The clause ﴿يناديهم﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. وأين: an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as an adverb of place, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). وشركائي: delayed mubtadaʾ (subject). وقالوا: a verb and its fāʿil. وآذناك: a past verb, its fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi. وما: negative. ومنا: fronted khabar. ومن: a redundant particle. وشهيد: genitive in form, in the position of nominative as delayed mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t:
﴿وضل عنهم ما كانوا يدعون من قبل﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. وضل: a past verb. وعنهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿ضل﴾. وما: fāʿil (agent). The clause ﴿كانوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. وكان: a deficient past verb, and the wāw is its noun; the clause ﴿يدعون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of كانوا. ومن قبل: ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وظنوا ما لهم من محيص﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. وظنوا: a past verb and its fāʿil. وما: negative. ولهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ومن: a redundant (ṣila) preposition. ومحيص: delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative in position and genitive in form by ﴿مِن﴾. The negation suspends (taʿlīq) the operation of the verb of supposing in form while it remains operative in position. The negative clause stands in place of the two objects of آذناك [Translator's note: so in the source; the context suggests ظنوا is meant here], because it has the meaning of "We have informed you" (أعلمناك), just as the preceding negative clause stood in place of the second object of آذناك.

muyesser-irab:49-49.t:
﴿لا يسأم الإنسان من دعاء الخير﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; it begins the description of man in his two states of hardship and ease. ولا: negative. ويسأم الإنسان: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent). ومن دعاء: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿يسأم﴾. والخير: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وإن مسه الشر فيئوس قنوط﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and إن is conditional, causing the jussive. ومسه: a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). والشر: fāʿil. The fāʾ links the apodosis. ويئوس: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. فهو يؤوس. وقنوط: a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:50-50.t:
﴿ولئن أذقناه رحمة منا من بعد ضراء مسته ليقولن هذا لي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam); إن is conditional, causing the jussive. وأذقناه: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ورحمة: second mafʿūl bihi. ومنا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted naʿt (adjective). ومن بعد: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of رحمة, or attached to ﴿أذقناه﴾. وضراء: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), made genitive with the fatḥa because it is a diptote on account of the extended alif of the feminine. The lām is the answer to the oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted because the answer to the oath stands in its place. وهذا: mubtadaʾ (subject). ولي: khabar (predicate); the lām is for entitlement, i.e. "I deserve it by my deeds" (أستحقه بعملي).
﴿وما أظن الساعة قائمة ولئن رجعت إلى ربي إن لي عنده للحسنى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. وما: negative. وأظن: an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). والساعة: the first object of أظن. وقائمة: its second object. The wāw is a conjunction; the lām prepares for the oath; وإن: conditional. ورجعت: in the position of jussive as the protasis. وإلى ربي: the preposition and the genitive noun are attached to ﴿رجعت﴾. إن with what falls within its scope is the answer to the oath. ولي: the khabar of إن. وعنده: ḥāl (circumstantial). The lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). والحسنى: the noun of إن. The clause ﴿إن لي عنده للحسنى﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the answer to the oath, since the oath precedes the condition.
﴿فلننبئن الذين كفروا بما عملوا ولنذيقنهم من عذاب غليظ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition), because it is a reply to the disbeliever's saying ﴿ولئن رجعت﴾. The lām prepares for the oath [Translator's note: so in the source; the lām here is usually parsed as the lām of the answer to an implied oath]. وننبئن: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis. والذين: mafʿūl bihi. The clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. و﴿بما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of genitive, i.e. "of that which they did" (بالذي عملوا); or maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿ما عملوا﴾ is genitive by the bāʾ, i.e. "of their deeds" (بعملهم); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿ننبئن﴾. ﴿ولنذيقنهم﴾: conjoined to ﴿لننبئن﴾. ومن عذاب: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of the omitted second object; ﴿مِن﴾ is partitive, i.e. "We will make them taste a punishment that is of a harsh punishment" (لنذيقنهم عذابا كائنا من عذاب غليظ). وغليظ: naʿt of ﴿عذاب﴾.

muyesser-irab:51-51.t:
﴿وإذا أنعمنا على الإنسان أعرض﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. وإذا: a future adverb (ẓarf) containing the meaning of condition. The clause ﴿أنعمنا﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb's being put in construct with it. وعلى الإنسان: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿أنعمنا﴾. The clause ﴿أعرض﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿ونأى بجانبه﴾: conjoined to أعرض; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿نأى﴾, because the bāʾ is for making the verb transitive (taʿdiya).
﴿وإذا مسه الشر فذو دعاء عريض﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. وإذا: a future adverb containing the meaning of condition. The clause ﴿مسه الشر﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb's being put in construct with it. فذو: the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ (rābiṭa), and ذو is khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. هو. ودعاء: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). وعريض: naʿt (adjective) of دعاء.

muyesser-irab:52-52.t: ﴿قل أرأيتم إن كان من عند الله ثم كفرتم به من أضل ممن هو في شقاق بعيد﴾: قل: an imperative verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent). وأرأيتم: the hamza is interrogative, followed by a verb and its fāʿil. The first object of رأى is omitted, its implied form being: أرأيتم أنفسكم, and the second is the interrogative clause. وإن: conditional. وكان: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its noun is latent, its implied form being "هو", i.e. the Quran. ومن عند: khabar (predicate). The Name of Majesty: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ثم كفرتم: conjoined to ﴿كان من عند الله﴾. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being: ﴿فأنتم أضل من غيركم﴾ (then you are further astray than others) or ﴿لا أحد أضل منكم﴾ (no one is further astray than you). The conditional clause is parenthetical between the first and second objects, with no grammatical position. ومن: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). وأضل: khabar. وممن: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿أضل﴾. وهو: mubtadaʾ. وفي شقاق بعيد: khabar. The clause ﴿هو في شقاق بعيد﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:53-53.t:
﴿سنريهم آياتنا في الآفاق وفي أنفسهم﴾: the sīn is for the future. ونريهم: an imperfect verb; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "نحن"; the hāʾ is first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). وآياتنا: second mafʿūl bihi; ونا: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The seeing here is visual, which is why the verb is made transitive to two objects only. وفي الآفاق: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of آياتنا. و﴿في أنفسهم﴾: conjoined to ﴿في الآفاق﴾.
﴿حتى يتبين لهم أنه الحق﴾: حتى: a particle of limit and a preposition. ويتبين: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after حتى; the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to His words سنريهم. أنّ with what falls within its scope is the fāʿil of يتبين.
﴿أولم يكف بربك أنه على كل شيء شهيد﴾: the hamza is for disapproving, rebuking interrogation, and the wāw conjoins to something implied that the context requires. ولم: a particle of negation, jussive and conversion (to past meaning). ويكفِ: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter. و﴿بربك﴾: the bāʾ is a redundant (ṣila) preposition, and ربك is the fāʿil of ﴿يكْفِ﴾, nominative in position and genitive in form by the bāʾ. The mafʿūl bihi is omitted, the implied form being: أولم يكفك ربك. و﴿أنه﴾: ﴿أن﴾ is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and the hāʾ is its noun. وعلى كل: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿شهيد﴾. وشيء: muḍāf ilayhi. و﴿شهيد﴾: the khabar (predicate) of أن. The interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أنه على كل شيء شهيد﴾ is badal (substitute) of ﴿ربك﴾, nominative in position and genitive in form, like the word it follows.

muyesser-irab:54-54.t:
﴿ألا إنهم في مرية من لقاء ربهم﴾: ألا: an opening particle for drawing attention (istiftāḥiyya). إنهم: إن is for emphasis and puts into the accusative, and هم is its noun. وفي مرية: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the omitted khabar (predicate) of إن. من لقاء: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مرية﴾. وربهم: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿ألا إنه بكل شيء محيط﴾: ألا: an opening particle for drawing attention. إنه: إن is for emphasis and puts into the accusative, and the hāʾ is its noun. بكل: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿محيط﴾. شيء: muḍāf ilayhi. ومحيط: the khabar of إن, nominative (marfūʿ). The two clauses ﴿إنهم في مرية﴾ and ﴿إنه بكل شيء محيط﴾ are resumptive, with no grammatical position.
